items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: I know Clayborne and Williams, they had a band, all them guys. They had a band.

ctx.x: I think he's him. He got burned out. Anyway, we're going to the hospital and all. He's once, but I think he's him. It's been so long. Oh, for them guys to play hard, you know, you see. But the people in the city said we're the best band. They all give it to us. Yeah, see them, them men, they eat cornbread, see. You know, eat sanders like your city rats. Oh, they give it to us. We used to have two line-outs on each side, on each band. They have a line. They have a line out too. I know Clayborne and Williams, they…
When did the guys start playing ragtime by ear? I wanted to ask you about that.
